title: Signal timing review
content: Compare signal timings using identical demand, routes, seed and simulation horizon. Check queue spillback and unfinished vehicles. A simulated benefit does not establish real-world effectiveness.
provenance: authored demonstration guidance; not official engineering standards

title: Waterlogging and drainage
content: Waterlogging can reduce usable road capacity. A local drainage survey and rainfall evidence are required before sizing a remedy. Costs in this application are illustrative, not approved public-works rates.

title: Traffic-linked air pollution
content: Vehicle idling is one possible emissions source. Air-quality observations alone cannot attribute pollution to traffic. Do not infer AQI or health effects from simulated CO2 emissions.

title: Energy and traffic
content: Streetlight outages and electricity consumption require utility confirmation. Synthetic load indicators in the dashboard are educational examples and are not metered utility data.
